in_sanskrit.name: Kp
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Shiva

It is believed to be the name of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and regeneration. This powerful deity is revered for his ability to destroy the old and make way for the new, thus symbolizing the cycle of life, death, and rebirth. Kp is also believed to represent wisdom, fearlessness, and strength.
